question: Does the s106 windowed-photometry polish phantom (manufacture Band A from arbitrary cross-survivors), and does it survive the production pipeline on seed 119?
hypothesis: The polish either discriminates (Band A only near truth) or phantoms (Band A from any cross-survivor); and the production pipeline reaches Band A on 119.
narrative_md: The s106 polish does NOT phantom — across 1107 stratified cross pairs, 0 reach Band A, 0 phantoms, 3 hi-fi confirms hold Band D. But it is not production-ready on 119: the s106 oracle-nearest pair is dropped by the s100 cross filter (single-shoot ω 104° off → C-pass fails), and the polish basin of convergence in ω-direction is only ~5° (a 4.25°-off seed reaches Band A reproducing 0.0300 bit-identically; a 104°-off production seed cannot). s106 is real but architecturally inaccessible. Uses the oracle pair + truth labels → not blind.
